verbosity.description: Verbosity level. 0 for normal output, 1 for extra info, 2 for debug. Maps to -v/--verbose flag.

output_format.description: Output format. 'simple' prints space-separated facts, 'json' prints a JSON object. Maps to --json flag.

exclude_hypervisors.description: List of hypervisor names to exclude from detection. Maps to -e/--exclude flag. Valid names derived from virt-what(1) FACTS section, e.g., docker, kvm, xen, vmware, virtualbox.

include_hypervisors.description: List of hypervisor names to explicitly include in detection. Maps to -i/--include flag. Valid names derived from virt-what(1) FACTS section.
